text: I'm a CSE student focused on backend systems and applied AI. I've built projects in distributed systems and machine learning pipelines.
Shipped a caching layer that cut API latency by 40% for a course project. Learned that premature optimization is real, but so is under-optimization.
I believe most CS students over-index on frameworks and under-index on reading other people's code.
Placed in the top 10 at a regional hackathon building a real-time collaboration tool.
